text.en:
The regional directors of DOLE and DFA shall remain
members of the RDC.
.

All previous issuances inconsistent with the provisions of this
Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the city of Manila, this and
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
day of October , in the year
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
